verdict.rationale: Mintlify Automations let users run the agent automatically on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on connected integration events (mintlify-docs-5). A redesign added pre-built automations for common use cases (mintlify-docs-57), and automation updates are billed as a defined action (mintlify-docs-58). missing for 10: documentation of custom rule logic (conditions or filters on events), action types beyond agent-driven content updates, a list of supported integration events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
